findings.evidence: `tendsto_yosidaLimit` at line 118 requires both `hdense : Dense (A.domain : Set X)` and `ht : 0 ≤ t`; `yosidaLimit` itself is an unrestricted `limUnder`.
findings.fix: Describe the unrestricted `limUnder` definition as a candidate/chosen value, and state explicitly that it is proved to be the limit only under `IsMDissipative A`, dense domain, and nonnegative time.
findings.issue: The module and definition docs call `yosidaLimit A t x` a limit for every real `t`, and line 74 omits density; convergence is only established for densely defined m-dissipative `A` at `t ≥ 0`.

findings.fix: Update the paragraph to reference `IsMDissipative.exists_contractionSemigroup_generator_eq` as the generation direction and retain the existing converse reference.
findings.issue: The `IsMDissipative` docstring still says the Lumer–Phillips generation theorem “is not yet available in this library,” which becomes false in this PR.

summary: The new limit documentation overstates when `yosidaLimit` is an actual limit, and the new theorem leaves an existing public docstring stale.
